🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 2, 2026

Moon and Mars hold a conjunction in Leo. Both in fire, and speaking the same dialect: the thing and its worth sit on top of one another today.

Easier — Deciding one thing completely instead of four things partly.
Harder — Telling your own preference apart from everyone else’s.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon in Leo sides with you before you have argued. Fire begins, and beginning asks little today. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. From Leo, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Earth holds on, and the holding is billed. Unchanged for two weeks: you know what it asks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you from Scorpio on plain terms, without privilege. Moon in Leo makes room for you, and then waits. Mutable air: two answers, and both are affordable. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Scorpio, Sun agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Cardinal water: the opening move is the cheap one. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon is with you, close enough to read the small print. Fixed fire: the holding and the held stop differing. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Retrograde since two weeks ago, Mercury is still re-reading.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, has the run of Libra and sets its own terms. From Leo, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Air moves first here, and first is enough. The Scorpio chapter closed four weeks ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Moon in Leo squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Water keeps its grip past the point it is worth. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. Moon trines you from Leo, meeting no resistance. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. The hold Mercury had a week ago is not there any more.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Venus squares you from Libra, and something has to give way. Cardinal earth meets a bill. The trine to Mars that held a week ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Mars faces you from Leo: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Fixed air: the grip is the expense. Seven days ago none of this was in place.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Scorpio, Sun concedes the point early. Mutable water: two answers, neither expensive. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.
